question: What changes in central-bank digital money does the Library record?
answer: The world record holds 25 dated moves on central-bank digital money in 10 regions, May 13, 2025 to July 1, 2026. It records moves, not a status, so each region below shows its latest move. Only two currencies have a stated status in a package: Japan's possible retail CBDC is 'pilot; not authorized' (September 15, 2026), and the UK digital pound is at grade M1, 'design decision pending' (September 14, 2026); a May 1, 2026 news report says it may be suspended instead, which is disputed and shown with both readings.

items.text: The Bank of Korea floats growing Han River into foreign-bond investment infrastructure. The disbursement clerk wants a passport.

items.title: The Bank of Korea relaunches Han River Phase 2 with nine banks — retooled around tokenizing government disbursements, 110 trillion won in grants, first pilot the EV-charging subsidies.
items.text: The Bank of Korea relaunches Han River Phase 2 with nine banks — retooled around tokenizing government disbursements, 110 trillion won in grants, first pilot the EV-charging subsidies. The state ledger survives by becoming the state's own payment clerk. The same move Russia made with pensions.
kv: Korea's CBDC Comes Back as the Government's Paymaster

items.title: The Bank of Korea tells the banks it is pausing Project Han River Phase 2 — the wholesale CBDC and tokenized-deposit trial.
items.text: The Bank of Korea tells the banks it is pausing Project Han River Phase 2 — the wholesale CBDC and tokenized-deposit trial. The banks had spent 35 billion won on Phase 1 and pivoted to stablecoins the moment Lee won. The state ledger loses its own partners to the token, one day after they formed their consortium.
kv: The Banks Walk Out on Korea's CBDC

items.text: The BIS Annual Economic Report 2026 — "Anchoring trust in money: innovation beyond stablecoins" — does not soften: stablecoins still fail the tests, and stablecoin dollarization of emerging markets is named a sovereignty threat. A year of the token pole winning everywhere, and the tower answers by raising its voice. The same day the EU Parliament clears the digital euro.

items.title: The BIS Annual Economic Report lays out the "next-generation monetary system": stablecoins fail the three tests of money — singleness, elasticity, integrity — and the future is a tokenized …
items.text: The BIS Annual Economic Report lays out the "next-generation monetary system": stablecoins fail the three tests of money — singleness, elasticity, integrity — and the future is a tokenized unified ledger anchored in central-bank money. The tower of central banks publishes its counter-manifesto five weeks before GENIUS is signed.
kv: Basel Says Stablecoins Are Not Money

items.title: Project Pine — the New York Fed and the BIS Innovation Hub, with the ECB, Bank of England and four others — proves central banks can run monetary policy in a fully tokenized system …
items.text: Project Pine — the New York Fed and the BIS Innovation Hub, with the ECB, Bank of England and four others — proves central banks can run monetary policy in a fully tokenized system: interest on reserves, asset purchases, collateral calls, all by smart contract. The central banks aren't fighting the ledger; they're learning to drive it.
kv: The Fed Practices Tokenized Monetary Policy

items.title: The ECON committee adopts the digital euro framework 43 to 14 — holding caps reviewed every two years, privacy-by-design, a 24-month rollout — and orders trilogues.
items.text: The ECON committee adopts the digital euro framework 43 to 14 — holding caps reviewed every two years, privacy-by-design, a 24-month rollout — and orders trilogues. The stated purpose, in the headline itself: reduce US dominance in payments. The last big parliamentary hurdle falls the same day Basel doubles down on stablecoins.

items.title: The Council adopts its negotiating position on the digital euro: the ECB sets holding limits inside a Council-defined ceiling, and cash gets reinforced legal-tender status in the same …
items.text: The Council adopts its negotiating position on the digital euro: the ECB sets holding limits inside a Council-defined ceiling, and cash gets reinforced legal-tender status in the same package. The member states bless the state ledger — with a leash on it.
kv: The Council Signs Off on the Digital Euro

items.title: The ECB closes the digital euro preparation phase and moves to the next stage: pilot transactions targeted for mid-2027, possible issuance 2029 — all contingent on the regulation passing in …
items.text: The ECB closes the digital euro preparation phase and moves to the next stage: pilot transactions targeted for mid-2027, possible issuance 2029 — all contingent on the regulation passing in 2026. While every other retail CBDC on Earth retreats, the euro's marches forward.
kv: The Digital Euro Gets Its Marching Orders

items.title: The Bank of Japan expands its blockchain settlement sandbox as a 2026 decision on the digital yen nears.
items.text: The Bank of Japan expands its blockchain settlement sandbox as a 2026 decision on the digital yen nears. Still the official line: no plans to issue. But the lab keeps getting bigger.
kv: The BoJ Widens Its Blockchain Sandbox

items.title: The BoJ publishes its CBDC pilot progress report — seven working groups, sixty-four firms — and keeps the official line: no plans to issue.
items.text: The BoJ publishes its CBDC pilot progress report — seven working groups, sixty-four firms — and keeps the official line: no plans to issue. The digital yen stays a laboratory animal while the private yen tokens go to market.
kv: The Bank of Japan Keeps Its Digital Yen in the Lab

items.text: The Reserve Bank's position paper rules out a retail digital rand — no strong immediate need — pivoting to wholesale experiments and bank-issued stablecoins on the existing rails. Another retail state ledger dies in a position paper.
kv: South Africa Shelves the Digital Rand

items.title: Cardoso forms a fifteen-member task force on an official naira stablecoin as the eNaira faces what officials call an existential crisis.
items.text: Cardoso forms a fifteen-member task force on an official naira stablecoin as the eNaira faces what officials call an existential crisis. (Announced at the IMF meetings; day unverified.) Africa's first CBDC — the app pulled offline, the USSD code dead — ends with its own central bank studying how to copy the private coin that beat it.
kv: Nigeria's Central Bank Gives Up on Its Own Coin

items.title: MAS announces a 2026 pilot issuing tokenized government bills settled with wholesale CBDC, plus draft stablecoin legislation.
items.text: MAS announces a 2026 pilot issuing tokenized government bills settled with wholesale CBDC, plus draft stablecoin legislation. The city-state does both poles at once, quietly, without a single speech about sovereignty.
kv: Singapore Readies Tokenized Bills and a Stablecoin Law

items.title: The Thai cabinet approves the G-Token — five billion baht of state borrowing issued as a digital token the public can buy in small pieces.
items.text: The Thai cabinet approves the G-Token — five billion baht of state borrowing issued as a digital token the public can buy in small pieces. Not a CBDC: the state tokenizes its debt, not its money. The same instinct as Britain's digital gilt, reached from Bangkok.

items.title: The e-CNY International Operations Center formally opens in Shanghai with three platforms: cross-border payment, blockchain service, digital assets.
items.text: The e-CNY International Operations Center formally opens in Shanghai with three platforms: cross-border payment, blockchain service, digital assets. The only retail CBDC on Earth with an export strategy gets its office.
kv: The Digital Yuan Gets an Export Office

items.title: PBoC Governor Pan Gongsheng, at the Lujiazui Forum, calls for a multipolar international monetary system and unveils eight measures — including an e-CNY international operations center in …
items.text: PBoC Governor Pan Gongsheng, at the Lujiazui Forum, calls for a multipolar international monetary system and unveils eight measures — including an e-CNY international operations center in Shanghai. The digital yuan formally aimed outward, at the dollar's rails.
kv: Pan Calls for a Multipolar Money Order

items.title: At Blockchain Rio, the DREX coordinator announces the CBDC is dropping blockchain entirely — repositioned as a Pix-integrated collateral utility.
items.text: At Blockchain Rio, the DREX coordinator announces the CBDC is dropping blockchain entirely — repositioned as a Pix-integrated collateral utility. (Day within the conference unverified.) The most advanced CBDC pilot in the Americas concludes the chain wasn't the point. Pix already won.
kv: Brazil's CBDC Gives Up the Chain

items.title: Federal Law 303-FZ amends the Budget Code: digital-ruble budget payments pilot from October, then any federal payment — pensions, scholarships, state salaries — from January 1, 2026 …
items.text: Federal Law 303-FZ amends the Budget Code: digital-ruble budget payments pilot from October, then any federal payment — pensions, scholarships, state salaries — from January 1, 2026, through a Federal Treasury digital-ruble account. The state ledger wins its first real user the same way Korea's would: by paying the people who can't say no.

items.title: Putin signs the mass-rollout law: systemically important banks and large merchants must handle digital rubles and the universal QR code from September 1, 2026, the rest by 2028.
items.text: Putin signs the mass-rollout law: systemically important banks and large merchants must handle digital rubles and the universal QR code from September 1, 2026, the rest by 2028. Nobody asked the banks whether they preferred stablecoins. The one retail CBDC that can't be paused by a committee is the one imposed by decree.
kv: Putin Makes the Digital Ruble Mandatory

The world record has no status field (live / paused / dropped); a status word would have to be read into each row's prose, so this page shows dated moves instead. The track also holds related items (BIS reports, tokenized government bonds).
Headlines in the record are editorial; each card leads with the record's own first sentence and keeps the headline below it.

International room exception: rows may keep news links. Every row's url is the single link the page showed; 163 of the 164 page cards were labelled 'Reconstructed (not an official filing)' and 1 'Saved link'. Treat row urls as source_kind news unless the host is an official body.
